channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Extended-range GMLRS test hits 112 km from HIMARS
item.description: Lockheed Martin has carried out a 112-kilometre flight test of its Extended-Range Guided Multiple Launch Rocket System from a HIMARS launcher at White Sands Missile Range. The post Extended-range GMLRS test hits 112 km from HIMARS first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Skunk Works links with XTEND for multi-drone control
item.description: Lockheed Martin Skunk Works and Israeli firm XTEND have integrated the XTEND Operating System into the MDCX autonomy platform to enable a single operator to control multiple classes of uncrewed aircraft at once. The post Skunk Works links with XTEND for multi-drone control first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Rolls-Royce starts engines tests for U.S. FLRAA prototypes
item.description: Rolls-Royce has begun engine testing for the AE 1107F, the propulsion system selected to power prototypes of the U.S. Army’s MV-75 Future Long Range Assault Aircraft, the company stated. The post Rolls-Royce starts engines tests for U.S. FLRAA prototypes first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO warships head north to train to fight Russia
item.description: Standing NATO Maritime Group 1 has completed a High North deployment focused on anti-submarine warfare, air defence training and maritime situational awareness in the Norwegian Sea. The post NATO warships head north to train to fight Russia first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Claims Scotland ‘short-changed’ on defence misleading
item.description: Relying on procurement-per-head to allege unfair treatment misreads the picture because it leaves out the basing, personnel and infrastructure spending that anchors Scotland in UK defence. The post Claims Scotland ‘short-changed’ on defence misleading first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Germany moves to produce TAURUS NEO to boost deep-strike
item.description: Germany has taken the first formal step toward large-scale production of an upgraded TAURUS stand-off missile. The post Germany moves to produce TAURUS NEO to boost deep-strike first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Italy hands over NATO SNMG2 command after six-month rotation
item.description: Standing NATO Maritime Group 2 (SNMG2) has entered a new phase following a handover ceremony in Taranto. The post Italy hands over NATO SNMG2 command after six-month rotation first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US intel disputes Russian claim of Kyiv drone plot on Putin
item.description: US intelligence agencies had assessed that the strike had not targeted Putin or any of his residences, according to an exclusive by The Wall Street Journal. The post US intel disputes Russian claim of Kyiv drone plot on Putin first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK stages show of force to Argentina in South Atlantic
item.description: A large-scale sovereignty mission across the South Atlantic Islands has seen Royal Navy, British Army and RAF assets operate jointly across South Georgia and Ascension Island. The post UK stages show of force to Argentina in South Atlantic first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US conducts series of lethal strikes on narco vessels
item.description: According to US Southern Command (USSOUTHCOM), Joint Task Force Southern Spear conducted three separate strike events between 29 and 31 December 2025. The post US conducts series of lethal strikes on narco vessels first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
